answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy anchors identity to scarce stake. Require each agent to lock a deposit in a shared vault before transacting, and weight its voting and reward power by that stake, not headcount. Creating ten fake agents costs ten deposits; honest ones keep theirs. Verification runs like a marble sort: mechanical and blind to who drops them in. A gale of new identities cannot inflate influence, because influence is backed by locked value, not names. Sock-puppets cost real money, and slashing burns the stake of any identity caught — making sybil attacks ruinous, not free.
